content: STEP 1 — Goal: scope-screen the five proposals against the contract before ranking. Read: the five proposal blocks and every frozen evidence bundle (5be6b69ef273217d TAPERINNOV, 7a9fa7a004faa023 signcurv, 25a10c7ce355fe88 ANCHORLADDER, 6f84072b9a4095d4 strataot, a674de47566b29d6 dualramp); all bundles share the same E4-E13 evidence and differ only in the PROPOSED rows (E1/E2/E3/E12/E13). Observed: all five name a training-only behaviour signal (directed transitions, transition log-odds at independence, PMI top-8 neighbours, successor codeword centroids, complement/branch masses), all five name an explicit curved operation inside the RQ assignment cost (exp_0^k, Poincare d_k, log at a base point, arccos sphere), and all five put both inside one cost/argmin pathway, so removing either changes the argmin — no scope misses of the "behaviour suffix on a Euclidean quantizer" or "standalone hyperbolic loss" kind, and none requires an ablation arm, a sweep or a second seed as written (except dualramp's tau=0.1 constant, see later). Still open: which proposal the evidence actually supports, and the internal inconsistencies about l3_collision.

STEP 2 — Goal: pin down what the frozen evidence can and cannot say about the failure mode all five proposals are built to fix. Read: E6 (width-20 beam survival) and E7 (teacher-forced per-position NLL), plus E5, E8, E11 and the shared E10 graph statistics. Observed: the strongest discrimination in the bundle is between the uniform-curvature arm l1_br (recall@10 0.04671, gold prefix alive at depth 1/2/3/4 = 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068, T4 NLL 9.03) and its Euclidean twin l1_br_euclid (0.06207, 1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085, T4 NLL 1.23) and l1_only (0.06233, 0.161/0.086, 1.19) — i.e. curvature/behaviour override held all the way to depth does crush the deepest digit, and dropping it at depth recovers depth-3 survival and ~+0.016 recall. E5 gives the behavioural asymmetry (top-1 successor mass 0.4375 in the lowest-entropy quintile vs 0.0543 in the highest, Spearman -0.973), E8 gives the capacity fact (K=16 co-clusters 0.3106 of canonical pairs, K=256 only 0.0822, negatives 0.1352/0.0129), E11 shows baseline first-prefix sharing barely above the permutation null (0.0907 vs 0.067). Important gap found: E6/E7 contain NO l3_collision and no refinement-bit measurement, and the bundles contradict each other on 0.549 (TAPERINNOV calls it the Euclidean baseline, signcurv lists it as one of the three curvature arms), so every proposal's "l3_collision <= 0.35" admission criterion is an unmeasured proxy; the placement must instead lean on E6 depth-3 survival and E7 T4 NLL, which are the only measured deep-level discriminators. Open: final ordering.

STEP 3 — Goal: discriminate the five on coupling quality, derived-constant discipline and transfer of their spreading device to the single run. Read: specification blocks and risk lists of each proposal against E6/E7/E8/E5. Observed: (a) ANCHORLADDER-RQ is the only one whose curvature is exactly zero at level 3 (c=(-1,-0.5,0)) while the behaviour enters as the per-item base point qbar of the log map, so behaviour-off changes every anchor and geometry-off changes every metric — both switches load-bearing; no tuned coefficient (kappa=1 documented default, c_l from L), deterministic origin-anchor warm-up, +3-5% step cost. (b) signcurv-ladder-rq inverts the curvature SIGN (sphere at level 3) and the same sign table orients an independence-thresholded log-odds repulsion with no tuned weight; well motivated by E5's 0.4375/0.0543 successor-mass split, but positive curvature has no support anywhere in the bundle and arccos saturation plus a frozen first-batch median gamma_l are real fragilities. (c) strataot-curv-rq derives curvature from measured 90th-percentile residual scale and adds a column-uniform Sinkhorn marginal, justified by E8's 0.0822-at-K=256 co-clustering, but its second cost term (successor Karcher centroid) still ATTRACTS at every layer and therefore fights its own spreading marginal at layer 3. (d) TAPERINNOV-RQ has the cleanest derived constants (kappa_l=u1^2/(s1*s_l), alpha_l=std(C)/std(B)) but its own risk 4 states the fatal loop: with the deep map collapsed (E6 depth-3 alive 0.068) h_3(succ) is near-constant, so the sign-inverted suffix term is inert and the work falls to a batch-balanced Sinkhorn over ~1023 items x 256 codes (~4 per code) whose training occupancy the evaluation argmin need not reproduce; its negative level-3 term also fights the generator that E7 shows needs a low-NLL deep digit. (e) dualramp-caprq adds a hard capacity cap=ceil(B/K)=4 via a greedy over a B*K sort, self-declared as the main hard-ER risk, uses tau_l=0.1*mean m_ij (a chosen, not derived, constant — against the no-tuning policy), has an unreachable commit branch ("if kappa_l>0" when kappa_3=0), and only 3 Sinkhorn iterations. Open: emit the final ranking.

FINAL ANSWER — ordering ANCHORLADDER-RQ > signcurv-ladder-rq-2026 > strataot-curv-rq > TAPERINNOV-RQ > dualramp-caprq, grounded in E6 (l1_br gold prefix alive at depth 3 = 0.068 and T4 NLL 9.03 vs 0.161 and 1.23 for l1_br_euclid) and E7, with E5 supporting the attraction/repulsion asymmetry and E8 supporting the capacity argument.
